description: Figure 12 illustrates how Pass@8 accuracy varies with generation temperature for three methods (On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT). The x-axis is labeled “Temperature” on a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 with tick marks at every 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8)” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 62.5 to 80.0 with evenly spaced tick labels at 2.5-point intervals. The On-policy RL series is drawn as an orange solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts near 67.5 at temperature 0.1, rises to about 70.0 by 0.4, dips to roughly 68.0 at 0.6, peaks around 72.5 at 0.8, and ends near 70.0 at 1.0. The LUFFY series is a red solid line with star markers; it begins around 75.0 at 0.1, reaches about 77.5 at 0.2, stays near 76.0–76.5 from 0.3 through 0.6, increases to about 78.5 at 0.7, remains around 78.0–78.5 at 0.8–0.9, and ends near 79.0 at 1.0. The SFT series is a teal solid line with downward-pointing triangle markers; it starts around 75.0 at 0.1, declines to about 73.5 by 0.4, rises to roughly 75.0 at 0.6, drops to about 72.5 at 0.7, and then increases to approximately 74.0 at 0.8 and about 74.5 at 1.0.
